description: The Sinew fitness capability in data: content pillars and routing keywords, per-form fitness rules, evidence grades, claim rules and the 10-dimension quality rubric. Read by scripts/fitness.py (classify, plan, dossier, review) and by the /fitness skill. Brand and asset rules: .claude/skills/fitness/.

brand.name: Sinew
brand.tagline: See what your body is doing.

voice.why: Warm documentary voice; slower than the workspace default so dense physiology stays followable. Tibi is the on-screen character; the narrator is Tibi's voice.

pillars.name: Strength training for running
pillars.description: Why and how runners lift: economy, load management, single-leg strength, programming alongside mileage.

pillars.name: Gym and bodybuilding
pillars.description: Hypertrophy, progressive overload, volume, intensity, exercise selection, technique, splits and programming.

pillars.name: Muscle growth, running and performance tips
pillars.description: Physiology and recovery: protein, creatine, sleep, fatigue, DOMS, warm-ups, cadence, VO2 max, aerobic base, lactate threshold, energy systems, myths.

fitness_rules: One claim, one mechanism, one visual system.
Tibi on screen in the first second, moving.
At most one evidence badge and one source line.
Portrait: Tibi at scale 1.25 or more, centred in the upper two thirds.

mid.structure: Hook -> Context -> Explanation -> Visual demonstration -> Conclusion
fitness_rules: The demonstration is a mechanism running inside Tibi's body or a chart of the key finding.
Every number on screen carries a source line.
Re-hook every 35-60 s with a question the next step answers.

long.structure: Hook -> Context -> Narrative development -> Deep explanation -> Resolution (in chapters)
fitness_rules: One mechanism per chapter; chapter cards from the brand kit.
A 'what we do not know' beat in at least one chapter.
Sources listed in the description and on the end card.

evidence_grades.label: Established mechanism
evidence_grades.use: Textbook physiology agreed for decades (for example the sliding filament model).

evidence_grades.label: Strong evidence
evidence_grades.use: Consistent systematic reviews or meta-analyses of RCTs.

evidence_grades.label: Moderate evidence
evidence_grades.use: Several RCTs or one good meta-analysis with limits (small samples, short duration, one population).

evidence_grades.label: Preliminary
evidence_grades.use: Few or small studies, animal or cell work, acute markers only.

evidence_grades.label: Hypothesis
evidence_grades.use: A plausible mechanism not yet tested directly in humans.

evidence_grades.label: Not supported
evidence_grades.use: Claims the evidence contradicts or does not support (myths).

claim_rules: Never fabricate a citation, a finding, a mechanism or a number; every claim in narration or on screen maps to a claim id in research/dossier.json.
Quote numbers as the study reported them, with the population and design on screen.
Acute markers (protein synthesis after one session) are not long-term outcomes (muscle growth over weeks); say which one the number is.
No muscle-activation percentages and no 'this exercise isolates' claims.
No diagnosis, injury treatment or individual prescriptions; injury topics carry the general-education line.

dimensions.name: Scientific accuracy
dimensions.question: Is every claim supported by the dossier, at the strength stated?

dimensions.name: Anatomical accuracy
dimensions.question: Are structures and muscle groups placed and named correctly for the level of stylisation?

dimensions.name: Biomechanical accuracy
dimensions.question: Are movements and joint mechanics plausible, and conceptual kinematics labelled as such?

dimensions.name: Visual consistency
dimensions.question: Does the film follow the Sinew brand (palette, type, layout, motion)?

dimensions.name: Character consistency
dimensions.question: Is Tibi on model in every view and expression?

dimensions.name: Storytelling
dimensions.question: Is the explanation understandable and engaging for the target viewer?

dimensions.name: Animation quality
dimensions.question: Are movements fluid, contacts planted, and timing right?

dimensions.name: Information density
dimensions.question: Does every scene contribute, with no dead stretches or overload?

dimensions.name: Audio quality
dimensions.question: Is narration clear, the mix balanced, loudness on target?

dimensions.name: Production efficiency
dimensions.question: Was the film built from the reusable kit rather than one-off art, within one build loop?

rubric.critical_rule: A scientific, anatomical or biomechanical error is a critical issue: the film fails until it is fixed and re-rendered, whatever the other scores.
